name: Youth Conservation Corps, National Parks of Boston
org: National Park Service, Boston National Historical Park
what_you_do: Work as a team with park staff to lead summer camp days for children from Boston youth groups. Trips visit park sites and the Boston Harbor Islands.
who_can_apply: Must be 15 on or before the first day and not turn 19 during the program. U.S. citizen, national or permanent resident. You must live locally. You should enjoy working with kids who are 7 to 12 years old.
duration: 2026 schedule: Monday June 29 to Friday August 21, about 30 to 35 hours a week, 9 AM to 4 PM
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed April 26, 2026 at 11:59 PM (rolling until then). 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: In 2026: download the YCC application form from the park page, add 1 or 2 references, scan it and email it to npb_youthprograms@nps.gov. Applications for 2026 are closed.
notes: Paid. Mon to Fri. No housing. Work includes safety duties with young campers and training on public land management. This is a federal job, so ask the park how the Massachusetts permit rule applies. Watch the park page in early 2027. Paid work for people under 18 in Massachusetts needs a work permit (employment permit). See permit.html?state=ma for the exact permit and steps.
